" alt="Committee portrait"><div class="copy"><div class="kicker">Committee</div><h3>Nicola Ogden</h3><p>Supporting the organisation, its students and its schools.</p></div></a></div></div></section></main>`)

routes['grade-order'] = () => shell(`<main>${pageHero('FROM FIRST STEP TO <em>BLACK BELT.</em>','Grade order','The full WJO belt progression in one clear place.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">WJO grading progression</div><h2>Every belt. In the right order.</h2></div><p>The only striped belts are the two Brown grades. Their red or black stripe runs lengthways through the centre of the belt.</p></div><div class="grade-roadmap-v55">${[['white','White','Starting grade'],['yellow','Yellow','Early development'],['orange','Orange','Building foundations'],['red','Red','Developing control'],['green','Green','Continued growth'],['blue','Blue','Advancing skills'],['purple','Purple','Advanced development'],['brown-red','Brown with red centre stripe','Advanced preparation'],['brown-black','Brown with black centre stripe','Final preparation'],['black','Black','Black belt']].map(x=>`<div class="grade-step-v55"><div class="belt-swatch-v55 ${x[0]}"></div><h3>${x[1]}</h3><p>${x[2]}</p></div>`).join('')}</div></div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Clear milestones</div><h2 style="font-size:51px;line-height:1">Progress made visible.</h2><p>Each grade gives students a clear next target while technical skill, confidence, discipline and understanding develop together.</p></div><div class="content-card light"><h3>Brown belt stripes</h3><p>Only the two Brown belt stages have stripes: Brown with a red centre stripe, followed by Brown with a black centre stripe. The stripe runs along the middle of the belt for its length, not across either end.</p></div></div></section></main>`)

routes.faq = () => shell(`<main>${pageHero('QUESTIONS BEFORE <em>YOUR FIRST CLASS?</em>','Frequently asked questions','Answers to common questions from parents, new students and returning members.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap" style="max-width:900px">${[
['How can Jado Kuin Do benefit me?','Confidence, discipline, coordination, balance, fitness and practical martial arts skills are central to the WJO approach.'],['How old can children start?','Depending on the club and child, students can start from around age three through the Super J\'s programme.'],['Do I have to grade?','No. Grading is optional, although belts provide recognition, progression and useful goals.'],['Could I achieve a black belt?','WJO presents black belt as an achievable pathway for students who learn consistently and progress through the system.'],['Do I have to enter competitions?','No. Competition is optional and separate from normal class progression.']].map(x=>`<div class="faq-item"><h3>${x[0]}</h3><p>${x[1]}</p></div>`).join('')}</div></section>${cta()}</main>`)

routes['find-school'] = () => shell(`<main>${pageHero('FIND YOUR <em>WJO.</em>','School finder','Search all WJO venues by town, postcode, programme or training day.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="v49-intro-band"><div><div class="kicker">Start close to home</div><h2>Your nearest class, without the hunt.</h2><p>Search by location, programme or training day, then open a venue to see its weekly timetable and book a free taster.</p></div><div class="v49-intro-pills"><div class="v49-intro-pill"><b>${SCHOOLS.length}</b><span>WJO venues</span></div><div class="v49-intro-pill"><b>3</b><span>Quick filters</span></div><div class="v49-intro-pill"><b>Free</b><span>First taster</span></div></div></div><form class="school-toolbar-v5" onsubmit="submitSchoolSearch(event)"><input id="school-query" class="field location-field" placeholder="Town or postcode" aria-label="Town or postcode"><select id="school-programme" class="field"><option value="">Any programme</option><option>Super J's</option><option>Confident Kidz</option><option>Adults</option><option>Jado Chi</option></select><select id="school-day" class="field"><option value="">Any day</option><option>Monday</option><option>Tuesday</option><option>Wednesday</option><option>Thursday</option><option>Friday</option><option>Saturday</option><option>Sunday</option></select><button class="btn red search-action" type="submit">SEARCH</button></form><div class="school-results-head"><p id="school-count"></p><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="clearSchoolSearch()">CLEAR FILTERS</button></div><div id="school-results" class="school-list-v5"></div></div></section></main>`)

routes.school = () => {const id=hashParams().get('id')||'brackley-leisure'; const s=SCHOOLS.find(x=>x.id===id)||SCHOOLS.find(x=>x.id==='brackley-leisure'); const schedule=s.sessions.length?s.sessions.map(x=>`<tr><td><b>${x[0]}</b></td><td><b>${x[1]}</b></td><td>${x[2]}</td><td>${x[3]}</td><td><a class="btn dark" href="#contact">BOOK</a></td></tr>`).join(''):`<tr><td colspan="5">Please contact WJO for the current class timetable at this venue.</td></tr>`; const progs=s.programmes.length?s.programmes.join(' • '):'Contact WJO for current programme details'; const dayText=s.days.length?s.days.join(' / '):'Contact WJO for current days'; const maps='https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query='+encodeURIComponent(s.address); const bg=schoolBgPath(s); const venuePanel=bg?`<div class="school-detail-map venue-photo-card" style="--schoolbg:url('${bg}')"><div><div class="kicker">${s.region}</div><strong>${s.town}</strong><span>${s.postcode}</span></div></div>`:`<div class="school-detail-map"><div><div class="kicker">${s.region}</div><strong>${s.town}</strong><span>${s.postcode}</span></div></div>`; return shell(`<main>${pageHero(`JADO KUIN DO <em>${s.town.toUpperCase()}.</em>`,'Local academy',`${s.name} • ${s.region}`)}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Your local WJO academy</div><h2 style="font-size:47px;line-height:1">${s.name}</h2><p style="color:#aeb3bc">${s.address}</p><div class="school-meta">${s.programmes.map(p=>`<span class="pill">${p}</span>`).join('')}<span class="pill">${dayText}</span></div><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn red" href="#contact">BOOK FREE TASTER</a><a class="btn ghost" href="${maps}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GET DIRECTIONS ↗</a></div></div>${venuePanel}</div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Weekly timetable</div><h2>Choose your class.</h2></div></div><table class="timetable">${schedule}</table></div></section><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-3"><div class="content-card"><h3>What to bring</h3><p>Comfortable sports clothing and water. No uniform needed for a taster.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Programmes</h3><p>${progs}</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Questions?</h3><p>Contact WJO before your visit if you need help choosing the right class.</p></div></div></section></main>`)}

function eventParts(e){const d=new Date(e.date+'T12:00:00');return {day:String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'),month:d.toLocaleString('en-GB',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase(),weekday:d.toLocaleString('en-GB',{weekday:'short'}),full:d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'})}}
function showEventDetails(id){const e=LIVE_EVENTS.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!e)return;const d=eventParts(e);let modal=document.getElementById('event-modal-v29');if(!modal){modal=document.createElement('div');modal.id='event-modal-v29';modal.className='event-modal-v29';modal.innerHTML='<div class="event-modal-card-v29" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><div class="event-modal-image-v29"><button class="event-modal-close-v29" type="button" aria-label="Close event details" onclick="closeEventDetails()">×</button><img id="event-modal-img-v29" alt=""></div><div class="event-modal-copy-v29"><div id="event-modal-kicker-v29" class="kicker"></div><h2 id="event-modal-title-v29"></h2><p id="event-modal-desc-v29"></p><div class="event-modal-meta-v29"><div><span>Date</span><b id="event-modal-date-v29"></b></div><div><span>Venue</span><b id="event-modal-venue-v29"></b></div><div><span>Location</span><b id="event-modal-location-v29"></b></div></div><p style="margin-bottom:0">This event information is stored inside the mockup, so viewing it does not leave the site.</p></div></div>';modal.addEventListener('click',ev=>{if(ev.target===modal)closeEventDetails()});document.body.appendChild(modal)}
 document.getElementById('event-modal-img-v29').src=resolveAssetPath(e.image);document.getElementById('event-modal-img-v29').alt=e.title;document.getElementById('event-modal-kicker-v29').textContent=e.category;document.getElementById('event-modal-title-v29').textContent=e.title;document.getElementById('event-modal-desc-v29').textContent=e.desc;document.getElementById('event-modal-date-v29').textContent=d.full;document.getElementById('event-modal-venue-v29').textContent=e.venue;document.getElementById('event-modal-location-v29').textContent=e.location;requestAnimationFrame(()=>modal.classList.add('open'));document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}
function closeEventDetails(){const modal=document.getElementById('event-modal-v29');if(!modal)return;modal.classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow='';}
function liveEventCard(e){const d=eventParts(e);return `<article class="event-row-v28" data-event-text="${(e.title+' '+e.venue+' '+e.location+' '+e.desc+' '+e.category).toLowerCase()}"><div class="event-thumb-v28"><img loading="lazy" src="${e.image}" alt="${e.title}"></div><div class="event-date-v28"><div class="day">${d.day}</div><div><div class="month">${d.month}</div><div class="weekday">${d.weekday}</div></div></div><div class="event-body-v28"><div class="kicker">${e.category}</div><h3>${e.title}</h3><p>${e.desc}</p><span class="venue">${e.venue} • ${e.location}</span></div><button class="btn ghost event-detail-button" type="button" onclick="showEventDetails('${e.id}')">VIEW DETAILS</button></article>`}
function renderMonthCalendar(year,month){const es=LIVE_EVENTS.filter(e=>{const d=new Date(e.date+'T12:00:00');return d.getFullYear()===year&&d.getMonth()===month});const first=new Date(year,month,1);const days=new Date(year,month+1,0).getDate();const start=(first.getDay()+6)%7;let cells='';for(let i=0;i<start;i++)cells+='<div class="event-day-cell empty"></div>';for(let day=1;day<=days;day++){const date=`${year}-${String(month+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`;const de=es.filter(e=>e.date===date);cells+=`<div class="event-day-cell ${de.length?'has-event':''}"><div class="event-day-number">${day}</div>${de.map(e=>`<button class="month-event-link" type="button" onclick="showEventDetails('${e.id}')">${e.title}<small>${e.venue}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`}const monthName=new Date(year,month,1).toLocaleString('en-GB',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});return `<section class="event-month"><div class="event-month-head"><div><div class="kicker">WJO Calendar</div><h2>${monthName}</h2></div><span>${es.length} event${es.length===1?'':'s'}</span></div><div class="event-calendar-scroll"><div class="event-calendar">${['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'].map(x=>`<div class="event-weekday">${x}</div>`).join('')}${cells}</div></div></section>`}
function setEventView(view){document.querySelectorAll('.event-view-switch button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===view));const list=document.getElementById('events-list-pane'),month=document.getElementById('events-month-pane');if(list)list.hidden=view!=='list';if(month)month.hidden=view!=='month'}
function filterLiveEvents(){const q=(document.getElementById('event-search')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();document.querySelectorAll('.event-row-v28').forEach(row=>row.hidden=q&&!row.dataset.eventText.includes(q))}
routes.events = () => shell(`<main>${pageHero('WHAT’S COMING UP <em>AT WJO.</em>','Events & gradings','The current WJO diary — gradings, black-belt promotions and organisation-wide social events.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="v49-intro-band"><div><div class="kicker">The WJO diary</div><h2>Gradings, milestones and community.</h2><p>Switch between a clean list and full month view. Every event opens into a dedicated detail page, with date, venue and event information in one place.</p></div><div class="v49-intro-pills"><div class="v49-intro-pill"><b>${LIVE_EVENTS.length}</b><span>Live event records</span></div><div class="v49-intro-pill"><b>2</b><span>Calendar views</span></div><div class="v49-intro-pill"><b>WJO</b><span>Event diary</span></div></div></div><div class="event-view-toolbar"><div class="event-view-switch"><button type="button" data-view="list" onclick="setEventView('list')">LIST</button><button class="active" type="button" data-view="month" onclick="setEventView('month')">MONTH</button></div><div class="event-search"><input id="event-search" class="field" placeholder="Search events, venue or club" oninput="filterLiveEvents()"></div></div><div id="events-list-pane" class="event-view-pane" hidden><div class="event-list-v28">${LIVE_EVENTS.map(liveEventCard).join('')}</div></div><div id="events-month-pane" class="event-view-pane"><div class="event-months">${renderMonthCalendar(2026,8)}${renderMonthCalendar(2026,9)}</div></div><div class="event-source-note">Select an event to see its date, venue and details.</div></div></section></main>`)

routes.event = () => {const id=hashParams().get('id')||'autumn-ball-oct-24';const e=LIVE_EVENTS.find(x=>x.id===id)||LIVE_EVENTS[0];const d=eventParts(e);return shell(`<main>${pageHero(`${e.title.replace(/\s+–\s+/,' <em>–</em> ')}`,'Event detail',`${d.full} • ${e.venue}`)}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div class="content-card"><div class="kicker">${e.category}</div><h2 style="font-size:44px;line-height:1">${e.title}</h2><p>${e.desc}</p><div class="profile-facts"><div><span>•</span>${d.full}</div><div><span>•</span>${e.venue}</div><div><span>•</span>${e.location}</div></div><a class="btn red" href="#events">BACK TO EVENTS</a></div><div style="border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;min-height:430px"><img src="${e.image}" alt="${e.title}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block"></div></div></section></main>`)}

routes.news = () => shell(`<main>${pageHero('STORIES FROM <em>THE WJO.</em>','News & insights','Organisation news, training insight, student stories and community activity.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="news-grid"><a class="news-card" style="--newsbg:url('assets/news-mental.jpg')" href="#article"><div class="tag">Wellbeing</div><h3>Why Jado Kuin Do matters for mental health</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">How training supports focus, routine, confidence, emotional balance and a sense of belonging.</p></a><a class="news-card" style="--newsbg:url('assets/news-newsletter.jpg')" href="#article"><div class="tag">WJO News</div><h3>Jado January Newsletter</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">The latest organisation updates, training news and instructor development.</p></a><a class="news-card" style="--newsbg:url('assets/news-reflection.jpg')" href="#article"><div class="tag">From the Founder</div><h3>2025 reflection letter</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">Grand Master Ogden reflects on growth, standards, community and WJO values.</p></a><a class="news-card" style="--newsbg:url('assets/news-newsletter.jpg')" href="#article"><div class="tag">Community</div><h3>Fun & Awareness Day</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">Daventry students, families and local services came together for a community event.</p></a><a class="news-card" style="--newsbg:url('assets/value-improvement-v2.png')" href="#article"><div class="tag">Development</div><h3>Social development and character building</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">How Jado training develops confidence, belonging and life skills alongside technique.</p></a></div></div></section></main>`)

routes.shop = () => shell(`<main><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="shop-hero"><div class="shop-hero-copy"><div class="kicker" style="color:#ffdadd">Official WJO shop</div><h1>TRAIN JADO.<br>WEAR JADO.</h1><p>Uniforms, sparring equipment, clothing, books, memberships and gifts from the official Jado range.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn light" href="#product?id=membership">BUY MEMBERSHIP</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#cart">VIEW BASKET (${cartCount()})</a></div></div><div class="shop-hero-art"><img src="assets/shop-all.jpg" alt="Official WJO martial arts range"></div></div></div></section><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="categories">${[['🥋','Uniforms'],['🥊','Sparring'],['👕','Clothing'],['📚','Books'],['🪪','Membership'],['🎯','Training'],['🎁','Gifts'],['↗','All products']].map(x=>`<a class="cat" href="#shop"><i>${x[0]}</i><h3>${x[1]}</h3></a>`).join('')}</div></div></section><section class="page-section alt"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Official WJO shop</div><h2>All core products in one place.</h2></div><p>Membership is surfaced as a first-class purchase option rather than feeling separate from the rest of the buying journey.</p></div><div class="shop-toolbar"><div class="filter-pills"><span>All</span><span>Uniforms</span><span>Sparring</span><span>Clothing</span><span>Books</span><span>Membership</span></div><a class="btn ghost" href="#checkout">GO TO CHECKOUT</a></div><div class="product-grid enhanced">${CATALOGUE.map(p=>`<div class="product enhanced"><div class="product-image"><img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.name}"></div><div class="product-copy"><span class="tag">${p.category}</span><h3>${p.name}</h3><p>${p.desc}</p><div class="price">${money(p.price)}</div><div class="actions"><a class="btn ghost" href="#product?id=${p.id}">DETAILS</a><button class="btn red" onclick="addToCart('${p.id}',1,'${(p.sizes&&p.sizes[0])||'Standard'}')">ADD</button></div></div></div>`).join('')}</div></div></section></main>`)

routes.product = () => {const id=hashParams().get('id')||'gi-adults'; const p=getProduct(id); const title=p.name.toUpperCase(); return shell(`<main>${pageHero(title,'Shop / '+p.category,'Product options, sizing information and a direct route to the basket.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap product-layout revised"><div class="product-main-image revised"><img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.name}"></div><div class="product-info"><div class="kicker">WJO ${p.category}</div><h1>${p.name}</h1><div class="price-big">${money(p.price)} <small style="font-size:13px;color:#aeb3bc">Inc VAT</small></div><p style="color:#aeb3bc">${p.desc}</p><div class="choice-grid"><div class="choice"><label>Option</label><select id="product-size" class="field" style="width:100%">${(p.sizes||['Standard']).map(s=>`<option>${s}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="choice"><label>Quantity</label><input id="product-qty" class="field" type="number" value="1" min="1" style="width:100%"></div></div><button class="btn red" onclick="addToCart('${p.id}',Number(document.getElementById('product-qty').value||1),document.getElementById('product-size').value)" style="width:100%;height:54px">ADD TO BASKET</button></div></div></section></main>`)}

routes.cart = () => {const items=getCart(); const rows=items.map(item=>{const p=getProduct(item.id); const line=p.price*item.qty; return `<div class="cart-row cart-row-v30"><div class="cart-thumb cart-thumb-v30"><img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.name}"></div><div class="cart-item-info"><h3>${p.name}</h3><span>${item.size}</span><button class="cart-remove" onclick="removeFromCart('${item.id}','${item.size}')">Remove</button></div><div class="cart-item-actions"><div class="qty-stepper" aria-label="Quantity"><button type="button" aria-label="Decrease quantity" onclick="changeCartQty('${item.id}','${item.size}',-1)">−</button><b>${item.qty}</b><button type="button" aria-label="Increase quantity" onclick="changeCartQty('${item.id}','${item.size}',1)">+</button></div><strong>${money(line)}</strong></div></div>`}).join(''); const subtotal=items.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+getProduct(item.id).price*item.qty,0); return shell(`<main class="cart-page-v30">${pageHero('YOUR <em>BASKET.</em>','Shop','Review your items and continue to checkout.')}<section class="page-section cart-section-v30"><div class="wrap checkout-grid cart-layout-v30"><div><div class="cart-table ${items.length?'':'empty-note'}">${items.length?rows:`<div class="cart-empty-v30"><h2>Your basket is empty.</h2><p>Go back to the shop and add uniforms, equipment or membership.</p><a class="btn red" href="#shop">BROWSE SHOP</a></div>`}</div>${items.length?`<a class="continue-shopping-v30" href="#shop">← Continue shopping</a>`:''}</div><div class="summary cart-summary-v30"><div class="kicker">Basket summary</div><h3>Order summary</h3><div class="summary-row"><span>Items</span><b>${cartCount()}</b></div><div class="summary-row"><span>Subtotal</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div><div class="summary-row"><span>Delivery</span><b>${items.length?'Calculated next':'—'}</b></div><div class="summary-row cart-total-v30"><span>Total</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div>${items.length?`<a class="btn red cart-checkout-v30" href="#checkout">SECURE CHECKOUT →</a>`:`<a class="btn dark" href="#shop" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px">GO TO SHOP</a>`}</div></div></section>${items.length?`<div class="mobile-cart-checkout-v30"><div><small>${cartCount()} item${cartCount()===1?'':'s'}</small><strong>${money(subtotal)}</strong></div><a href="#checkout">CHECKOUT →</a></div>`:''}</main>`) }
routes.checkout = () => {const items=getCart(); const subtotal=items.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+getProduct(item.id).price*item.qty,0); return shell(`<main>${pageHero('CHECKOUT <em>WITHOUT THE CLUTTER.</em>','Shop / Checkout','A streamlined single-page checkout with large touch targets, clear delivery choices and a readable order summary.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap checkout-grid"><div><div class="content-card"><h2>Contact & delivery</h2><div class="form-grid"><input class="field" placeholder="First name"><input class="field" placeholder="Last name"><input class="field wide" placeholder="Email"><input class="field wide" placeholder="Address"><input class="field" placeholder="Town / city"><input class="field" placeholder="Postcode"><select class="field wide"><option>Standard UK delivery</option><option>Collect via instructor / club</option></select></div></div><div class="content-card" style="margin-top:14px"><h2>Payment</h2><div class="field">Card / supported WooCommerce payment gateway</div></div></div><div class="summary"><h3>Your order</h3>${items.length?items.map(item=>{const p=getProduct(item.id); return `<div class="summary-row"><span>${p.name}<small>${item.size} • Qty ${item.qty}</small></span><b>${money(p.price*item.qty)}</b></div>`}).join(''):`<div class="summary-row"><span>No products selected yet</span><b>£0.00</b></div>`}<div class="summary-row"><span>Total</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div><button class="btn dark" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px">PLACE ORDER</button></div></div></section></main>`)}

routes.account = () => shell(`<main>${pageHero('YOUR <em>ACCOUNT.</em>','Shop / My account','Manage orders, addresses, account details and membership information in one place.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-3"><div class="content-card"><div class="icon-circle">↗</div><h3>Orders</h3><p>Track and review recent WJO shop orders.</p></div><div class="content-card"><div class="icon-circle">⌂</div><h3>Addresses</h3><p>Manage billing and delivery details.</p></div><div class="content-card"><div class="icon-circle">◎</div><h3>Account details</h3><p>Name, email and password settings.</p></div><div class="content-card"><div class="icon-circle">🪪</div><h3>Memberships</h3><p>Link to WJO membership products and renewal guidance.</p></div><div class="content-card"><div class="icon-circle">♡</div><h3>Wishlist</h3><p>Save equipment and clothing for later.</p></div><div class="content-card"><div class="icon-circle">←</div><h3>Log out</h3><p>Securely end your session.</p></div></div></section></main>`)
